brief:
A late-1930s painted-cel animated film: characters with inked contour lines and flat opaque gouache-like paint with one soft shadow tone, over a rich watercolor-and-gouache background painting with warm glowing lamplight and atmospheric depth.
The scene: a night street: a warm plaster wall with an arched doorway and a green door, a glowing wall lamp above the door, a dark red brick wall on the left, a black iron street lantern in the right foreground, and a clock tower against the dark blue night sky behind.
The characters: Bram, a tall, sturdy lamplighter with a charcoal flat cap, brown hair, a big round nose, rosy cheeks, a thick curled handlebar moustache, a long deep-red wool coat with brass buttons and flap pockets over a dark sweater, a long cream knitted scarf with fringed ends wrapped around his neck with one end hanging down his chest, and dark trousers; and Pip, a small child about half Bram's height with auburn hair, wearing a yellow sou'wester rain hat, a yellow duffle raincoat with dark toggles, black trousers and teal rain boots.
One continuous six-second shot with a completely fixed, wide camera. Bram stands in the middle of the frame facing us; the arched doorway is just to his right.
0-1s: Bram waits by the lamplit doorway and the green door swings open.
1-2s: Pip peeks out around the door frame and steps out beside it; Bram hears something.
2-4s: Bram turns toward Pip and waves back with his right hand raised in front of him; Pip waves eagerly with one arm out to the side.
4-6s: Pip gives a happy hop and heads back inside; Bram settles, smiling. Bram's scarf stays wrapped around his neck and its end sways slightly.
No other characters, no cuts, no text, no dialogue, no music.

revision.operation: Keyframe edit (GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst) + reference-guided regeneration (H3 Max)
revision.instruction:
Recreate Video 1 shot for shot: the same characters, the same performance and timing, the same fixed camera, background and lighting.
The only change: Bram's scarf is now blue, exactly as in the opening frame. Keep it blue in every frame.

about: Draft tier. Both conditions used MiniMax H3 Max on fal on 2026-11-01 with the same brief, duration, resolution and aspect ratio and prompt expansion disabled, but through different endpoints (text-to-video vs reference-to-video), so this is a workflow comparison, not a controlled benchmark of one parameter. No seeds were set. The reference images were upscaled 2× to meet the endpoint's 256 px minimum. Four takes per condition show behavior; they are not a success rate.
reviewStatus: Draft notes: written by Claude on 2026-11-01 from frames sampled once per second, full-resolution spot checks and pixel-difference measurements, against the brief and the approved references. Awaiting approval by a human editor. Timestamps are approximate (±0.5 s).
